message.content: I usually wake up around nine, like a normal person. My sister makes me breakfast, which is porridge most days. Then I get dressed and take the bus to the shop. The bus ride is quiet, and I like that. When I get to work, I start by pricing the notebooks and organizing the pen display. I also check the till to make sure everything is in order. It's a simple routine, and I find that helps me stay calm. Sometimes, though, I hear a voice when I'm alone. It doesn't happen all the time, just now and then.
